shared_tail.surface: أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب

notes: Four «ح» branches (written «و- حدثنا») meet at كميل بن زياد النخعي; the words «قَالَ: أَخَذَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ» after the last branch belong to all four, so Ali is the shared tail (rule 3, owner ruling 5: the one who speaks in the narrated encounter is the last link).
«وَ اللَّفْظُ لِفُضَيْلِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ عَنْ كُمَيْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ» is a remark on the wording that names a transmitter already in the first branch: left out.
The report number «2-» and the blessings are not part of any surface. «أبي» is the compiler's shaykh, bare kinship: relation.
